model: DA20-C1 Landing & Rolling Distance — POH Table 4. Direct lookup (not a nomogram); values read verbatim.
source: Diamond DA20-C1 Flight Manual, Table 4 — Landing and Rolling Distances for Heights Above MSL (DOC# DA202-C1, Rev 27)
conditions: Throttle idle, max T/O weight, 55 KIAS approach, level paved runway, landing flaps, standard MSL. Distance varies with height above MSL only.
disclaimer: Poor maintenance or unfavourable conditions (high temperature, rain, wind, slippery runway) can increase landing distance considerably. The POH is authoritative — verify before flight.
notes: Verbatim POH table; interpolated linearly between the tabulated MSL heights. Ground idle set to 1000 RPM increases landing distance ~5% and ground roll ~7%.
